# Town4 Media Group

> Town4 Media Group uses AI to develop workflows and templates for business through AI solutions architecture for everyday operators.

Town4 Media Group is a brand of Advisors Group International Inc.

Town4 Media Group uses AI to develop workflows, templates, and agent automation for businesses through AI solutions architecture: assistants, systems, and communications that run themselves.

## Services

Small-business systems: Notion templates; Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 templates; AI skills and assistants; business communications; custom workflows.

Design: custom design and artwork; vectorize and recreation; shop-family design for Travel Shertz, Souvenir Safari, and Texas Shirt Works.

Shopify store builds and maintenance: Town4 Media Group builds new Shopify shops and takes care of the ones you already have. (See /shopify/.) Every shop is different; a quote comes after talking through what is needed.
